parents.course: Adv Topics in Asian Am Studies

ns2:section.sectionText: Topic: Asian American Intellectual and Cultural Studies. This course will explore the dynamics of elite and popular culture, the influence of Marxism and neoconservatism, biography and social history, the evolution of race theorizing, and the question what constitutes Asian America and who counts as an Asian American. Meets with HIST 472, sections G4 and U3.
